person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating third person, moving among Catherine, Demiris, and other characters and sometimes presenting their direct thoughts. The diagnostic Goodreads passages agree with the authorized opening, while chapter-indexed web passages corroborate the same pattern across the book. First-person wording in q01118 and similar web excerpts is locally attributed thought or dialogue, not an autonomous first-person narrative section. No evidence of sustained first- or second-person base narration was found; the only limitation is the absence of an explicit whole-book narratological description.
